KH0682.why: The KFG records the collector-name 'Eduard Gaffron' as the find-spot of Basel IVc.366.03. The museum's records have the cordage excavated from a burial ground near Huacho by Arnold Masarey and bought from him in 1910.
evidence: Forcart 1911, annual report of the Basel museum for 1910, pp. 194, 196: excavated 'in a burial ground near Huacho' by Dr Arnold Masarey
Nordenskiold to Sarasin, December 1924 (Museum der Kulturen archive): 'the one from Huacho [IVc.366.03]'
both quoted in Medrano 2022, PhD thesis, University of St Andrews, ch. 4 (with the 1910 payment of 400 marks to Masarey)
